annotations.title: Get a shopping link for a product or search page

description: Takes a product or search page address (url, or urls up to 5) and returns a McClipFace go link to that page, tracked when McClipFace earns from the store (credited false: untracked). url null (blocked store, cart page): don't link it. Use the url as is; never show a raw store link.

url.description: A public product or search page address at a store (http or https; never a cart, checkout, account or order page).

urls.description: Instead of url: up to 5 such addresses; results come back in the same order.

name: wrap_link
title: Get a shopping link for a product or search page
